oracle_provenance: Standard, foundational DSP frequency-resolution relationship (delta_f=fs/N); independently hand-verified before implementation. Not copied from any shared Skill fixture.
scope: Bounded FFT frequency-resolution planning check; not an executed instrument measurement or windowing-aware model.

cases.question: Does a 4096-sample record at 48kHz achieve at least 20 Hz resolution?
Does the same record fail to achieve a much tighter 1 Hz target resolution?
Must a record of only 1 sample be rejected as structurally insufficient for any FFT?
Does doubling the planned record length halve the frequency resolution figure, confirming the model's own inverse relationship rather than an arbitrary scaling?
